subject: Request: evidence snapshot for AWS Marketplace listing
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha@nimhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Carl Jensen <sec-ops@nimhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence snapshot for AWS Marketplace listing

Hi Mateo,

We are moving Redwood Inference through our Marketplace procurement gating for AWS co-sell and need a compact evidence package we can hand to the security and procurement review team. Specifically they asked for:

- SOC 2 report or an executive summary plus date of last audit
- Pen test statement or attestation letter (redacted if necessary)
- Fully executed DPA or an unsigned DPA template and expected turnaround for signature
- A short inventory mapping (matrix) that ties each item to the Marketplace requirement checklist

Can you send a single zip or a short Share link with these items? Our deadline for the gating review is COB Monday (23 Nov). If there are any controls gaps we should be aware of, flag them now.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Reed
Sr. Procurement Manager, Nimbus Health
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence snapshot for AWS Marketplace listing

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. We can put together what you requested. Quick notes/asks from our side: 

- SOC 2: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II executive summary and a time-limited full report access under an NDA. Our last audit period ended 2026-06-30; auditor: Greylock Assurance.
- Pen test: we have a third-party pen test attestation letter (we will redact tester IPs and customer identifiers). Please confirm if redaction of internal hostnames is acceptable.
- DPA: we can provide a signed DPA for Nimbus once we have a countersigned DocuSign. I'll include a pre-signed copy we typically share with marketplaces.
- Inventory mapping: Kimberly (copied) will assemble the mapping spreadsheet and add a short notes column explaining where evidence lives (Drive/secure link).

Target: consolidate into a single evidence bundle and share via secure Drive link by EOD Monday (2026-11-23). If you need sooner, let us know which items are highest priority.

Action: Kimberly, can you prepare the inventory and attach SOC/pen summary stubs? Karthik — can you confirm we can share the full SOC under NDA and prepare a redaction plan for the pen test?

Thanks,
Mateo
Sr. Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Reed <samantha@nimhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Carl Jensen <sec-ops@nimhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence snapshot for AWS Marketplace listing

Thanks Mateo — Monday is fine. A couple of follow-ups from the security team: 

- Please ensure the pen test redaction removes any external-facing IPs and any PII in sample logs; they specifically asked to not receive raw IP addresses.
- The SOC 2 executive summary is fine for initial review; procurement will request the full report if the review advances.
- For the DPA: procurement wants a DocuSign link or a contact who can sign within 48 hours.

Priority order for Nimbus: (1) DPA signed copy, (2) pen test attestation (redacted), (3) SOC 2 executive summary + link under NDA, (4) inventory mapping.

If you can confirm the signing contact, we'll start the DocuSign flow.

Best,
Samantha
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence snapshot for AWS Marketplace listing

Hi Samantha — attaching the initial evidence inventory and the two summary stubs we can share publicly. See attachments: marketplace_evidence_inventory.xlsx, redwood_soc2_summary_v3.pdf, redwood_pen_test_statement_redacted.pdf.

We have redacted external IPs and sample log snippets from the pen test statement; retained the attestation language and remediation status. For the full SOC 2 report, we require an NDA — we can spin up a short form NDA and provision a time-limited link to the full PDF once countersigned. Link to internal Drive (for your reference only): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/evidence/DEAL-9872 (internal).

DocuSign: I'm sending the DPA to your DocuSign address (Samantha). Our signatory is Karthik Iyer (VP, Security & Compliance) and he has authorized 48-hour turnaround.

Quoted for context:
> On Fri, 20 Nov 2026 at 11:26 AM Samantha Reed <samantha@nimhealth.com> wrote:
> > Please ensure the pen test redaction removes any external-facing IPs...

Let me know if you need additional fields in the inventory mapping (control owner, evidence path, expires).

—Kimberly
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: evidence snapshot for AWS Marketplace listing

Samantha — forwarding the bundle (zip link below) and DocuSign link for the DPA. Attachments included: redwood_soc2_summary_v3.pdf, redwood_pen_test_statement_redacted.pdf, redwood_dpa_signed_nimhealth.pdf, marketplace_evidence_inventory.xlsx.

Secure bundle (expires 7 days): https://securefiles.redwood.com/download/DEAL-9872-evidence-bundle
DocuSign (DPA): https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?doc=0a9b8c

If Nimbus needs the full SOC 2 prior to formal approval, please have your legal/security team sign the NDA and send it to legal@redwood.com. Karthik will be the signer on our side and is standing by to countersign.

Thanks everyone — let us know if any follow-up evidence is requested during the gating review.

Best,
Mateo
Sr. Partnerships, Redwood Inference
